open_obligations: Check the sample size behind the C2 to C3 drop (last two GAOKAO Math questions only).
Note that the recursion is critique-of-critique, not agents trained to assist in training stronger agents.
Compare with the Human-Human C3 results, which improved, before concluding errors accumulate.
out.other_title: Do errors accumulate across levels of recursive reward modeling?
out.rationale: Leike et al. ask whether errors accumulate or are dampened across recursive levels. Wen et al. report human accuracy of 43.75% (response), 53.12% (critique), 56.25% (C2) and 54.69% (C3) when judging Qwen2.5-7B self-critiques, so the third level falls below the second while staying above the AI's own C2-stage accuracy; this is a critique chain at inference time, not recursive reward model training.
out.scope: proposed ADDRESSES: whether adding recursive levels of AI-assisted evaluation keeps improving human accuracy, for humans judging Qwen2.5-7B recursive self-critiques on GAOKAO Math
